import React from 'react';

const icon = (path, opts = {}) => {
  const { fill = false, size = 18 } = opts;
  return ({ width = size, height = size, ...rest } = {}) => (
    <svg
      width={width}
      height={height}
      fill={fill ? 'currentColor' : 'none'}
      stroke={fill ? 'none' : 'currentColor'}
      strokeWidth="2"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      {...rest}
    >
      {path}
    </svg>
  );
};
